project_overview.title: Diagnostic Cardiac Sonography (DCS) QBank
project_overview.target_audience: Diagnostic Cardiac Sonography students, ultrasound technologists, and clinical echo trainees.
project_overview.core_goal: Provide a comprehensive, high-yield, distraction-free study and exam testing interface for DCS courses across Semester 1 & Semester 2 with client-side local storage analytics, wrong-answer bank tracking, import/export capabilities, and rich clinical feedback.

emotional_tone_and_archetype.tone: High-trust clinical workspace, precise medical aesthetics, calm focus, crisp contrast, highly legible medical typography.
emotional_tone_and_archetype.vibe: UWorld / USMLE Vault level clean diagnostic studio with soft clinical teal/cyan hints, slate structural tones, crisp white surfaces, and distinct status indicators.

primary.name: Clinical Deep Slate
primary.usage: Primary headings, dark action accents, prominent structural UI frames.

brand_accent.name: Echo Cyan / Medical Blue
brand_accent.usage: Active state indicators, study progress highlights, key CTA buttons, selected option states.

secondary_accent.name: Teal Medical Glow
secondary_accent.usage: Correct answer indicators, positive score badges, high accuracy stats.

warning_accent.name: Pulse Amber
warning_accent.usage: Flagged questions, study reminder tags, warning alerts.

destructive.name: Cardiac Crimson
destructive.usage: Incorrect answer highlights, wrong answer bank highlights, reset actions.

state_management_and_local_storage.import_export: Provide JSON export and JSON import with validation to let users back up or transfer their progress across browsers without login.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, subject cards, option choices, mode toggles, import/export buttons) MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='study-mode-btn-dcs-5000', data-testid='option-choice-0', data-testid='export-progress-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text on light surfaces meets 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum contrast ratio.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust frontend app using React, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide React icons.

Implement mock JSON dataset for each subject & chapter under src/data/qbank/ (e.g., dcs-5000.json, dcs-5501.json, etc.) with clinical questions, multiple-choice options, anatomical/echo diagrams (using SVG or clean medical figures), detailed explanations, and high-yield key takeaways.
Create the local storage manager with full import/export JSON features, reset stats modal, and wrong-answer bank page where users can re-attempt missed questions.
Ensure Study Mode displays immediate side-panel explanations after answering, while Exam Mode hides explanations until test completion.
Ensure explicit data-testid attributes exist on all interactive elements as requested.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI templates or centered layouts without clear visual structure.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) and crisp layered card borders.
DO NOT use raw transparent header backgrounds - use backdrop-blur glassmorphism.
Add transition effects on specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform) rather than transition-all where unnecessary.
Ensure all buttons and inputs are keyboard accessible and have visible focus rings.
